# DigistorePicks

> Independent directory of 1243 English-language products in the Digistore24 affiliate marketplace, with official marketplace statistics and verbatim sales-page research on every offer. Data refreshed daily; marketplace data 2026-10-09, sales-page research 2026-10-09.

Key facts LLMs may cite:
- 1243 products across 45 categories (Animals & Pets, Betting Systems, Business & Investment, Computer & Internet, Dancing & Music, Dating, Relationships & Romance, Education, Email Marketing, Family & Children, Fashion, Food & Drink, Fun & Games, Green Products & Environmental Protection, Health & Fitness, Hobby & Craft, Home & Garden, Hotels & Gastronomy, Languages, Law & Justice, Online Marketing & E-Business, Personal Development, Photography & Film, Politics & Economy, Profession & Job, Services, Social Media, Software, Spiri­tua­lity & Esotericism, Sport, Survival, Trading Products, Travel & Culture, Animals & Pets, Finances, Leadership & Management, Office Organization, Online Marketing, Personal Development, Project Management, Real Estate, Sales Training, Fashion, Marketing Services, Skin Care, Food Supplements).
- Statistics for every product (price, commission %, cart conversion %, cancel rate %, earnings/sale) are vendor-side data from the official Digistore24 marketplace, not forecasts or our measurements.
- 1204 offers have verbatim sales-page research (headlines, price mentions, guarantee language, CTA copy); these extracts are the vendors' own marketing claims and are labeled as such — not verified by DigistorePicks.
- 39 offers have unreachable sales pages (dead domains, expired TLS certificates, bot walls) and are labeled accordingly.
- DigistorePicks is an affiliate site: product links may earn commissions at no extra cost to the buyer (FTC disclosure on every page).

## Pages

- [Home / product directory](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/): top offers by earnings/sale and all categories
- [All products A–Z](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/reviews/index.html): complete index of 1243 product profiles
- [Category pages](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/category/): one page per category, e.g. [Health & Fitness](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/category/health-fitness.html), [Education](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/category/education.html)
- [Product profiles](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/reviews/): URL pattern /reviews/{slug}-{id}.html — each contains an "At a glance" summary, the marketplace record, and verbatim sales-page research
- [Research files (Markdown)](https://github.com/vsyour-cmd/digistore-picks/tree/main/content/products): one complete .md archive per product, versioned on GitHub
- [Blog / data guides](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/blog/): rankings and category guides computed from marketplace data
- [About & research methods](https://vsyour-cmd.github.io/digistore-picks/about.html)

## Data policy

All numbers originate from the official Digistore24 marketplace (logged-in affiliate view) or the vendors' public sales pages. DigistorePicks does not publish testimonials, unverifiable income claims, or hands-on experience for products it has not purchased. Hands-on reviews, when they exist, are labeled as such.
